question.text: The binding energy per nucleon of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mtext> </mtext><mn>16</mn></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math> is <math><mn>7.97</mn><mi> </mi><mi>MeV</mi></math> and that of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mtext> </mtext><mn>17</mn></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math> is <math><mn>7.75</mn><mi> </mi><mi>MeV</mi></math>. What is the energy in <math><mi>MeV</mi></math> required to remove a neutron from <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mtext> </mtext><mn>17</mn></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math> ?

solution.text:
BE per nucleon O 16=7.97 MeV

BE per nucleon O 17=7.75 MeV

O17→n10+O16

The energy required to remove a neutron

=17×7.75-16×7.97

=4.23 MeV
